title: Backend Service Readiness Boundary Review
summary: Recorded a Backend-owned service readiness contract and health envelope so the default local server, internal-alpha storage, and local PDF candidates are not mistaken for production readiness.
expectedOutput: Backend-owned evidence or implementation that separates local development readiness from production service, persistence, auth, and export readiness claims.
riskSummary: Production remains blocked: top-level health status stays ready for probe compatibility, while auth, tenancy, storage provider selection, PDF export mounting, workers, renderer/provider binding, deployment, TLS/proxy, rate limits, telemetry, backup, and rollback remain unaccepted.
